caption:
The appraisal cycle slipped. foundit's Appraisal Trends Report 2026 found letters that normally land by mid-year are now arriving in Q3, Q4, and into the festive bonus window. 52% of India's professionals are already interviewing.

So a very large number of qualified people are about to sit in compensation conversations and skip-level meetings they did not plan for.

That room is not won by your deck. It is won by how you hold the pause after you state your number.

Most people fill that silence. They justify. They hedge. They name a figure and then talk it downward before anyone has answered. Thirty-five years of command teaches you the opposite: state the position, stop talking, let the weight of it sit on the other side of the table.

Bearing before argument. Tone before volume. Silence is not absence. It is pressure, applied deliberately.

Check whether your letter is actually going out this month. Then decide which conversation you are preparing for.

topic.title: Delayed appraisal cycle pushes half of India into job-hunting
topic.angle: This is the passed-over-for-promotion audience at peak intent — 52% are already interviewing, which means they are sitting in exactly the compensation and skip-level conversations where bearing, tone and calculated silence decide the number.
topic.why_now: foundit's Appraisal Trends Report 2026 (late July) found the cycle slipped later than usual, so appraisals that normally resolve by mid-year are landing in Q3/Q4 and into the festive bonus period — worth verifying letters are actually going out this month.
